notes.title: Leaving Early Access soon
notes.content:
Hi guys,

Next year is coming and the game is going to be close to leaving Early Access.
This time I want to announce 0.9.5 with a lot of changes.

[list]
[*] Splash Video added when starts.
[*] UI has received some changes to make it better.
[*] More gamepads compatibility added.
[*] Camera TV bug fixed.
[*] Performance issue solved when playing several games in a row.
[*] Replays works smoother.
[*] New Pass animations added.
[/list]

See you soon with the final release and more news.

Cheers,
Ruben

notes.title: PATCH 0.6.0 adding Cup mode
notes.content:
[h2]CUP MODE[/h2]

Finally, I finished the Cup mode adding EuroCup and AmericaCup with all teams on 2021 editions.
So now, you can play Friendly Games, Trainings, Leagues and Cups.

[h2]NEW UI[/h2]

Also, you will find a new different look in Buttons and other elements in UI, now it looks more like cartoon style.


Hope you like it and enjoy the cups, see you next week in another exciting update.

Cheers,
Rubén

notes.title: Patch 0.3.5 with keyboard support
notes.content:
A new weekend and a new update of SUPER ARCADE SOCCER 2021 arrives! ːsteamhappyː

This time 0.3.5 with a lot of bugs solved and any improvement, but the most important add is...

[h2]KEYBOARD SUPPORT[/h2]

From now, if you want to play with keyboard you can use ArrowKeys and Z,X,C,A. I hope to add redefine keys in future.

See you next week in the next big update, probably 0.4.0.

Cheers,
Ruben
